facts: The wind was 25 knots and there were 2m waves.
The course designated for race 5 of ILCA 6 Men Yellow fleet was O2.
When GRE 221447 arrived at the end of leg 3, there was only one of the two gate marks (3S/3P) in place.
SI 10.4 requires that if one gate mark is missing the remaining mark will be left on port.
GRE 221447 passed the mark leaving it to starboard and continued sailing on the next leg.
GRE 221447 finished the race and returned ashore.
After returning ashore, GRE 221447 retired from the race.
conclusions: GRE 221447 did not leave the remaining mark of gate 3S/3P to port and failed to comply with SI 10.4.
GRE 221447 failed to sail the course and broke RRS 28.1.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since GRE 221447 took an applicable penalty, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).
